findings.reason: the plan must name mast_efit_referee.py and mast_parity_chain.py as the second and third owners of the mechanism and retire or extend each, rather than asserting a single shared comparator when two parallel implementations survive.
findings.text: `_boundary_distance` re-implements the symmetric mean nearest-point boundary separation that nova/equilibrium/boundary_comparison.py owns (`compare_closed_boundaries`, symmetric_sup/rms_distance_m); the same mechanism is re-implemented a second time at nova/imas/mast_parity_chain.py:498 (`_lcfs_distance`, "symmetric nearest-point distance between seed and solved boundaries"). The plan's §3 asserts "one shared closed-boundary comparator wired into both EFIT harnesses", but neither MAST-side implementation imports boundary_comparison, so the claim is contradicted at two sites the plan never lists. This is a census of the whole duplicate type, not the first instance — both MAST-side owners are named above and no other independent implementation exists in nova/ or benchmarks/ (grep for the `0.5 * (mean(min)) + mean(min)` shape finds only these two)

findings.reason: the gate should consume the comparator's typed topology_class_agreement on both cohorts, or the plan must state why the MAST cohort re-derives it, if the demonstration is to have one agreement owner rather than one per cohort.
findings.text: `_mast_score` re-derives class agreement (computed_agreement) from the bank's `nova_achieved_class` and `efit_label` fields and nulls the row when the bank's own `label_agreement` disagrees, adding a second agreement authority beside the value `compare_closed_boundaries` already wrote into the bank; the DIII-D path (`_diiid_score`, line ~185) instead consumes `metrics.topology_class_agreement` directly, so the two cohorts of one gate do not use the same authority. The wrapper re-implements a decision the comparator owns instead of consuming it

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — the mechanisms the plan names already hide substantial behaviour behind small interfaces (nova/equilibrium/separatrix_branches.py:assemble_separatrix_branches, nova/equilibrium/boundary_comparison.py:compare_closed_boundaries, nova/equilibrium/flux_surface_connectivity.py:polish_stationary_points), not a spread of shallow wrappers.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — the shared symmetric nearest-point boundary distance the plan calls "one shared comparator wired into both EFIT harnesses" is still independently implemented in two MAST-side modules the plan does not name.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; the plan's sections add no CLI, MCP or refusal-family surface and the machinery sections name what they retire (ForwardTopologyState.diverted, the local-quadratic position authority), so no added surface is left unaccounted.
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — the plan's §2 landed a 25-candidate reuse map (docs/figures/efit-baseline-demonstration/reuse-map.md) that names traced_spline_contour, fit_tensor_spline, xpoint_candidates and the imas-ambix oracle, and §3 cites the mechanisms it extends.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: a finding — the demonstration gate re-derives the topology-class agreement instead of consuming the comparator's own field.
